system.boundary: Build a physically causal tractor drivetrain with a hydrostatic continuously variable transmission.
engineering_objects: Build a physically causal tractor drivetrain with a hydrostatic continuously variable transmission.

The system must include a governed prime mover, a variable-displacement hydraulic pump, a closed hydraulic loop with charge-flow and pressure protection, hydraulic motors that drive both the front and rear axles, a finite-mass tractor body, four tire--soil contacts, and an implement that applies a physical field load.
Hydraulic pressure and flow must transmit power from the prime mover through the pump and motors to the driven wheels.
physical_paths: Hydraulic pressure and flow must transmit power from the prime mover through the pump and motors to the driven wheels.

Across the declared operating range, the tractor must track the commanded speed without prescribed vehicle motion, remain dynamically stable from a cold start, keep hydraulic pressure and flow finite, and preserve the causal path from speed error through the variable pump and hydraulic transmission to vehicle motion.
